## Reporting period and boundary
This Metrics and Targets section covers the reporting year **2024**, with the fiscal year ending **31 December 2024**. Metrics are prepared on a **financial control** boundary.

## Operational greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions
This subsection provides the operational emissions metrics used to monitor climate-related performance for the reporting period.

### Operational emissions (Scopes 1 and 2)
Operational emissions are reported for **Scope 1** and **Scope 2** (both location-based and market-based).

| Metric | 2024 result | Unit |
|---|---:|---|
| Scope 1 GHG emissions | 2,634.9 | tCO₂e |
| Scope 2 GHG emissions (location-based) | 6,963.5 | tCO₂e |
| Scope 2 GHG emissions (market-based) | 3,060.5 | tCO₂e |

**Scope 1 boundary note (fleet):** Scope 1 includes fleet emissions.

**Scope 2 market-based accounting approach:** The market-based Scope 2 figure is sourced from utility invoices and reflects market-based accounting using grid emission factors adjusted for renewable energy certificates and power purchase agreements. Renewable energy certificate registry information is used for disclosure narrative and is not subtracted again in the preparation of Scope 2 market-based emissions.

### Selected Scope 3 category metric (business travel)
Business travel emissions are reported as a Scope 3 metric for the reporting period.

| Metric | 2024 result | Unit |
|---|---:|---|
| Scope 3 (business travel) | 289.9 | tCO₂e |

## Financed emissions (Scope 3 Category 15)
This subsection provides financed emissions metrics used to monitor climate-related performance associated with lending and investment activities.

### Financed emissions — corporate loans
Financed emissions for corporate loans are calculated using the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF) approach for corporate loans (PCAF Standard §B62). In plain language, the method attributes a share of a borrower’s total GHG emissions to the bank based on the bank’s **outstanding loan amount** relative to the borrower’s **enterprise value including cash (EVIC)**.

Financed emissions and the associated loan exposure are presented below.

| Reporting year | Financed emissions (loans) | Total loans | Unit |
|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 2022 | 36,550,177.7 | 31,150.64 | tCO₂e; €m |
| 2023 | 37,427,593.2 | 31,150.64 | tCO₂e; €m |
| 2024 | 35,973,167.7 | 31,150.64 | tCO₂e; €m |

For 2024, the bank’s financed emissions from loans were **35,973,167.7 tCO₂e**.

### Financed emissions — listed equity (proxy input)
For listed equity, the bank applies a PCAF listed equity approach (PCAF Standard §B61) using **issuer revenue** as the proxy input in the attribution model.

For 2024, the listed equity positions included in the financed emissions dataset are denominated in **EUR** and are measured using market value (and, where available, nominal amount). The proxy basis applied to these listed equity positions is **issuer revenue**.

Selected listed equity position metrics for 2024 are summarised below.

| Asset class | Reporting year | Market value | Nominal amount (where available) | Currency | Proxy input |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Listed equity | 2024 | 23.93 | 27.98 | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 556.40 | 636.77 | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 35.36 | — | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 79.11 | — | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 25.57 | — | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 1,886.33 | — | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 2,564.65 | — | EUR | Issuer revenue |
| Listed equity | 2024 | 288.08 | — | EUR | Issuer revenue |

## High-carbon sector exposure
This subsection provides the metrics used to monitor exposure to high-carbon sectors.

For 2024, high-carbon sector exposure was:

- **€11,059.49 million**
- **35.5%** (as a share of the relevant exposure measure used for this metric)

## Internal carbon pricing
This subsection describes internal carbon prices used in decision-making and monitoring.

The bank applies internal carbon prices expressed in **EUR per tCO₂e** for different application scopes:

| Application scope | Internal carbon price | Application to lending decisions | Application to financed emissions |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Investment decisions | 42.73 | Yes | Yes |
| Product pricing | 48.73 | No | No |
| Investment decisions | 54.73 | Yes | No |

## Climate-related targets and progress
This subsection summarises the climate-related targets used to monitor progress, including the metric, baseline, interim milestones (where set), and progress in 2024.

### Target TGT001 — Scope 1 and Scope 2 absolute reduction
**Purpose:** This target is used to monitor progress in reducing operational emissions.

- **Scope coverage:** Scope 1 and Scope 2 (whole entity)
- **Target type:** Absolute reduction
- **Metric used to set and track the target:** tCO₂e (absolute)
- **Baseline:** 137,849.0 tCO₂e in **2020**
- **Target ambition:** **42%** reduction (percentage reduction target)
- **Interim milestones:**
  - 2025: **120,480.0 tCO₂e**
  - 2028: **97,321.4 tCO₂e**
- **Progress in 2024:** **40.0%**
- **Status:** On track
- **Third-party validation:** Validated by **SBTi**

### Scope 3 Category 15 financed emissions intensity target (sectoral decarbonisation)
**Purpose:** This target is used to monitor progress in reducing financed emissions intensity associated with lending.

- **Scope coverage:** Scope 3 Category 15 (financed emissions; whole entity)
- **Target type:** Percentage reduction
- **Metric used to set and track the target:** tCO₂e per €m lending
- **Baseline:** 20.0 tCO₂e per €m lending in **2022**
- **Target ambition:** **30%** reduction (percentage reduction target)
- **Interim milestones:**
  - 2025: **18.2 tCO₂e per €m lending**
  - 2028: **15.8 tCO₂e per €m lending**
- **Progress in 2024:** **25.0%**
- **Third-party validation:** Validated by **UNEP FI**

### All-scopes target (with planned use of carbon credits)
**Purpose:** This target is used to monitor progress across all scopes.

- **Scope coverage:** All scopes (whole entity)
- **Baseline:** 120,000.0 tCO₂e
- **Progress metric:** Percentage reduction versus baseline
- **Progress in 2024:** **13.3%**
- **Planned carbon credits:** **8.2%** of the target is planned to be met using **technology removal** carbon credits.

A total of **21,080 tCO₂e** of carbon credits is reported in the carbon credit summary.

## Emissions data-quality mix (financed emissions)
This subsection provides the mix of data-quality approaches used in the financed emissions inventory.

The financed emissions data-quality mix is summarised below:

| Data-quality approach | Share |
|---|---:|
| Estimated (economic) | 47.5% |
| CDP disclosure | 35.5% |
| Proxy model | 16.3% |
| Audited report | 0.7% |

These data-quality categories are used to support consistent monitoring of financed emissions and progress against the bank’s financed emissions target metrics.
